# Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai

Dubai\| UAE

Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the Middle East's first and only Trump-branded address, developed by DarGlobal on Sheikh Zayed Road at the entrance to Downtown Dubai. The development combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in one building. Units span 109 to 722 sqm across one- to three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, with sea or Burj Khalifa views from every unit.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?

Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the first and only Trump-branded development in the Middle East, delivered by DarGlobal. It combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in a single address on Sheikh Zayed Road, with direct access to Downtown Dubai.

### What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?

The Trump Residences offer one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, ranging from 109 to 722 sqm. Every unit is positioned to deliver a guaranteed view of either the Arabian Sea or the Burj Khalifa.

### When will Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai be completed?

The project is under development with handover scheduled for December 2031. DarGlobal is the master developer. Buyers purchasing off-plan should contact the DarGlobal sales team directly for current payment plan terms and availability.

### Where exactly is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai located?

The tower sits on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, giving residents direct access to Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountains, and the Burj Khalifa district while bypassing the congestion of central Downtown.

### Does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai have the world's highest pool?

Yes. The development features the highest outdoor infinity pool in the world, reserved exclusively for residents of the Trump Residences. The rooftop pool overlooks the full Dubai skyline and is one of the project's defining headline amenities.

### What is the Trump Members-Only Club?

The Trump Members-Only Club is a private club within the tower, accessible by annual membership fee with residents receiving priority access. It includes a signature bar, cigar lounge, golf simulator, spa treatment rooms, meeting rooms, and a dedicated pool.

### What amenities are exclusive to residents of the Trump Residences?

Residents have exclusive access to the world's highest rooftop infinity pool, a state-of-the-art gym, an owners lounge, and a children's play area. Membership to the Trump Members-Only Club is available separately for access to the wider lifestyle facilities within the building.

### Is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai a good investment?

The project sits in one of Dubai's highest-demand corridors, combining a globally recognised brand, a world-record amenity, and direct Downtown proximity. Branded residences in Dubai have historically commanded rental premiums over comparable unbranded units; buyers should seek independent advice on investment suitability.

### How does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai differ from other luxury towers in Dubai?

It is the only development in the Middle East to combine a Trump five-star hotel, a residents-only world-record infinity pool, and a private members club under one address. The hotel-residential structure gives owners access to hotel-grade services alongside private ownership.

### How do I register interest or enquire about buying at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?

Prospective buyers can register interest, download the project brochure, or book a private viewing through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

whyInvest.description: Ras Al Khaimah, the fourth-largest emirate in the United Arab Emirates, is home to the newly opened RAK Market, which launched just two years ago. Some of the most desirable areas include Al Marjan Island, Al Hamra Village, and Mina Al Arab. Al Marjan Island's development strategy focuses on attracting a broad spectrum of international investors by offering luxurious amenities, serene ocean views, and a resort-style community. The emphasis on beachfront luxury, combined with the promise of high returns, positions Al Marjan Island as a prime destination for investment in the UAE's real estate market. The government has announced the opening of a WYNN Casino on Al Marjan Island itself in 2.5 years. This announcement has doubled market price over the past two years.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin?

The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin is a beachfront residential development on Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah, developed by DarGlobal. Aston Martin's design team applied the brand's precision and craftsmanship to each unit, producing a collection of one- to three-bedroom residences and three-bedroom beach villas directly on the water's edge.

### What unit types and sizes are available at The Astera?

The Astera offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences and three-bedroom beachfront villas ranging from 61 to 265 sqm. All units feature Aston Martin-designed interiors and sit on Al Marjan Island with direct beach access.

### What did Aston Martin design at The Astera?

Aston Martin's design team was responsible for the interiors of every residence, applying the brand's approach to precision, material quality, and artisanal craftsmanship to kitchens, bathrooms, and living spaces. The collaboration integrates cutting-edge design with the timeless finishes associated with the Aston Martin brand.

### When will The Astera be completed?

The Astera is under development with handover scheduled for December 2028. DarGlobal is the master developer responsible for delivery on Al Marjan Island. Contact the sales team for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan terms.

### Where exactly is The Astera located?

The Astera is on Al Marjan Island, a man-made island off the Ras Al Khaimah coastline, 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. It sits approximately 5 minutes from the upcoming Wynn Resort on Al Marjan Island, the first casino resort in the Middle East.

### What amenities does The Astera offer?

Amenities include direct beach access, an infinity pool, spa, sauna, pool bar, fitness centre, indoor cinema, yoga lawn, multipurpose hall, children's play area, and premium 24/7 security. Beach villas offer private access to the shoreline directly from the residence.

### Is The Astera a good investment in Ras Al Khaimah?

Al Marjan Island is an emerging market where average apartment capital values rose approximately 35% in a single year. Branded residences historically command price premiums of 30 to 200% over comparable unbranded stock, and the Wynn Resort announcement has been directly linked to market price doubling over two years. Buyers should seek independent investment advice.

### What is the UAE Golden Visa benefit for buyers at The Astera?

Buyers investing 2 million AED or more in UAE real estate may apply for a 10-year Golden Visa. The UAE applies 0% income tax and 0% property tax, providing a tax-efficient holding environment for both resident and international buyers.

### How does the Wynn Resort affect Al Marjan Island property values?

The announcement of the Wynn Resort on Al Marjan Island, the first casino resort in the Middle East, has been directly linked to a doubling of market prices over the past two years. The resort will be approximately 5 minutes from The Astera and is expected to drive further tourism and rental demand for beachfront properties on the island.

### How do I register interest or buy at The Astera?

Buyers can register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can provide current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

This landmark residence is a tribute to the timeless genius that shaped both Pagani's vision and these extraordinary homes.

# Da Vinci Tower, Interiors by Pagani

Dubai\| United Arab Emirates

Da Vinci Tower is the world's first residences by Pagani, a branded residential tower in Downtown Dubai, developed by DarGlobal with interiors crafted by Pagani Automobili. An architectural marvel designed to captivate, its striking façade is balanced on a one-of-a-kind geometric structure that creates a dynamic visual effect commanding attention. At its heart lies the pearl, a suspended sphere that adds a touch of wonder to this masterpiece.

Rising 19 floors above the Dubai Canal, with three basement levels and a grand ground floor, the tower offers an unmatched view of the iconic Burj Khalifa and sits just moments from Marasi Business Bay. Its 2, 3 and 4-bedroom residences range from 77 to 398 sq m, with opulent interiors by Pagani that embody the meticulous artistry and innovation inspired by Leonardo da Vinci himself. This landmark Pagani residence is a tribute to the timeless genius that shaped both Pagani's vision and these extraordinary homes.

## Frequently Asked Questions - Da Vinci by Pagani

### Who developed Da Vinci Tower?

Da Vinci Tower is developed by DarGlobal in partnership with Pagani Automobili and is the world's first Pagani-branded residential development.

### Where is Da Vinci Tower located?

Da Vinci Tower is located in Downtown Dubai, directly on the Dubai Canal, with views of the Burj Khalifa and moments from Marasi Business Bay.

### What types of residences are available at Da Vinci Tower?

The tower offers 2, 3 and 4-bedroom residences ranging from 77 to 398 sq m, each with private outdoor areas and panoramic views of the canal and Downtown Dubai.

### Is Da Vinci Tower really the first Pagani residential project?

Yes. Da Vinci Tower is the world's first residential development with interiors by Pagani, applying the brand's design philosophy to luxury living.

### What do the Pagani-designed interiors include?

Interiors crafted by Pagani feature premium leather, Italian marble, kinetic chandeliers, carbon fibre accents and lush wood panelling.

### What amenities does Da Vinci Tower offer?

Amenities include a rooftop pool overlooking Downtown Dubai, a state-of-the-art gym, sauna and steam rooms, 24/7 concierge, and private access to the residences through discreet elevators.

### How tall is Da Vinci Tower?

The tower rises 19 floors above the Dubai Canal, with three basement levels and a grand ground floor.

### How far is Da Vinci Tower from key Dubai landmarks?

The Dubai Mall and Fountains are about 9 minutes away, and Dubai Marina is around 20 minutes away.

### Can international buyers obtain UAE residency by purchasing here?

Buyers investing AED 2 million or more qualify for the UAE 10-year Golden Visa, and Dubai applies 0% income tax and 0% property tax.

### What makes Da Vinci Tower unique?

Da Vinci Tower is the world’s first residential development by DarGlobal with interiors designed by Pagani Automobili, bringing the design philosophy of the iconic Italian hypercar manufacturer into luxury living.

Amenities include an infinity pool, cutting-edge gym, grand entrance lobby, ground-floor retail, covered parking, and 24/7 concierge services. The tower sits directly on the Dubai Canal, providing immediate waterfront access as a lifestyle amenity in itself.

### What was the investment case for Urban Oasis by Missoni?

Urban Oasis by Missoni offered a Missoni-branded waterfront address on the Dubai Canal, a corridor that has seen strong capital appreciation as Business Bay has matured into one of Dubai's premier residential and commercial districts. Dubai offers 0% income tax, 0% property tax, and a 10-year Golden Visa with qualifying investments of 2 million AED or more.

### How does Urban Oasis by Missoni compare to other branded projects on the Dubai Canal?

Urban Oasis is one of few completed, fully delivered branded residences with direct canal frontage in Business Bay. Its combination of an Italian fashion brand interior, private elevator penthouses, and 360-degree canal and city views placed it in a distinct segment of the Dubai branded residence market.

### Can I buy a resale unit at Urban Oasis by Missoni?

As the project is sold out at the developer level, any available units would be on the secondary market. DarGlobal can advise on current availability or direct interested buyers to appropriate channels. Contact the team at darglobal.co.uk for further information.

### What other DarGlobal branded residence projects are available in Dubai?

DarGlobal has developed multiple branded residential projects in Dubai and across the region, including Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai and DG1 on the Dubai Canal. Visit darglobal.co.uk to explore the current portfolio and available projects.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is W Residences in Downtown Dubai

W Residences is a branded residential tower in Downtown Dubai, developed by DarGlobal in partnership with W Hotels, part of the Marriott Bonvoy portfolio. The tower brings W Hotels' bold, energetic lifestyle philosophy to a residential address in the heart of Downtown Dubai, with the Burj Khalifa directly outside and Dubai Mall within walking distance.

### Is W Residences sold out?

Yes. W Residences Downtown Dubai is sold out and fully completed. Any available units would be on the secondary market. Contact DarGlobal at [darglobal.co.uk](https://darglobal.co.uk/) for guidance on resale availability or to explore current DarGlobal projects.

### What unit types were available at W Residences?

W Residences offered one-, two-, and three-bedroom branded apartments in Downtown Dubai. The tower featured a W Lounge, infinity outdoor pool, clubhouse, cutting-edge fitness centre, a private cinema, co-working spaces and meeting rooms, a game room, complimentary guest suites, and a terrace with a dining area and walk track.

### Where is W Residences located in Dubai?

W Residences is in Downtown Dubai, strategically positioned by Business Bay. Key distances from the entry data: Burj Khalifa 5 minutes, Dubai Fountain 4 minutes, Dubai Canal 3 minutes, Dubai Mall 6 minutes, Dubai Opera 6 minutes. The Burj Khalifa and Dancing Fountains are visible directly from the tower.

### What does W Hotels bring to a residential building?

W Hotels, born from New York City's bold 24/7 culture, brings a "rebel luxury" philosophy to W Residences. Common areas including the W Lounge, lobby, and amenity spaces reflect the brand's energetic approach to design and hospitality, extending the W hotel experience to private residential living.

### What amenities does W Residences offer?

The tower includes an infinity outdoor pool, cutting-edge fitness centre, clubhouse, private cinema and communications space, game room and chill-out area, co-working offices with meeting rooms, terrace with dining and walk track, and complimentary guest suites for residents.

### What are the investment advantages of Dubai real estate?

Dubai offers a 10-year Golden Visa with a 2 million AED investment (now including off-plan properties), 0% income tax, and 0% property tax. It is ranked first globally for safety and is one of the top five most-visited cities in the world, home to more than 120 nationalities.

### Can I buy a resale unit at W Residences?

As W Residences is sold out at the developer level, units are available on the secondary market only. DarGlobal can assist with enquiries or direct buyers to appropriate resale channels. Visit darglobal.co.uk or contact the sales team directly.

### What other DarGlobal projects are available in Dubai?

DarGlobal has delivered and is currently developing multiple branded and non-branded residential projects in Dubai, including properties in Downtown Dubai and Business Bay. Visit darglobal.co.uk to explore the current portfolio and available projects.

content.title: Albert Hall Mansions History
content.description: Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.

content.title: Albert Hall Mansions History
content.description: Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.

content.title: Albert Hall Mansions History
content.description: Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.

content.title: Albert Hall Mansions History
content.description: Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.

content.title: A prestigious Address
content.description: The Albert Hall Mansion is situated in one of London’s most prestigious neighborhoods, directly overlooking the iconic Royal Albert Hall. This historic and architecturally significant building offers residents breathtaking views as well as an exclusive address. The location provides the perfect balance between the vibrant energy of city life and the tranquility of a refined residential area.

content.title: Location
content.description: Albert Hall Mansions is ideally located in one of London's most prestigious neighborhoods, directly overlooking the iconic Royal Albert Hall. This historic building offers breathtaking views and an exclusive address, balancing the vibrant energy of city life with the tranquility of a refined residential area. Situated in South Kensington, residents have access to Hyde Park, the Victoria and Albert Museum, and the luxury shopping of Knightsbridge, along with an array of fine dining, shopping, and cultural attractions. This location is perfect for those seeking a sophisticated and dynamic lifestyle.

## A World First

Introducing the Top of the Astera – the world’s first villa in the sky with interiors by Aston Martin. Rising above Al Marjan Island, this masterpiece redefines luxury, offering breathtaking views and unparalleled elegance. Experience the prestige of living above the clouds and beyond the ordinary.

![outdoor lounge](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/Untitled_1_1_8c895d583c.jpg)

## Beyond the Clouds

This exclusive villa offers direct beach access and stunning front-row views. Designed to blend sky-high sophistication with seaside grandeur, it delivers an extraordinary living experience.

![Ocean view](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/J001493_DG_03_Marjan_Sky_Villas_S05_Ethereal01_B_web_9d4d078dac.jpg)

## ELEVATE YOUR WORLD

Residents arrive in unmatched style via a private elevator leading directly to their villa. With meticulously designed interiors by Aston Martin, every detail speaks of refined craftsmanship and world-class luxury.

![Aston Martin-designed](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/J001493_DG_03_Marjan_Sky_Villas_S01_Top_View_Final_web_1198d85393.jpg)

## THE LIVING SPACES

Step into a timeless expression of design. The living areas are curated with bespoke furnishings and materials, echoing the signature elegance of Aston Martin’s automotive legacy. Each space is designed to complement your lifestyle, offering both comfort and sophistication.

![Luxury residential building](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/J001493_DG_03_Marjan_Sky_Villas_S02_View_From_The_Back_Sunset_Final_web_78a6da5572.jpg)

## LOCATION

Nestled on Al Marjan Island, the Top of the Astera offers direct beach access, is minutes away from the Wynn Resort, and just 45 minutes from Dubai International Airport, placing you at the heart of exclusivity and convenience.

![al marjan island ras al khaimah](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/AL_MARJAN_ISLANDS_2_1_5222c5e631.jpg)

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Tierra Viva?

Tierra Viva is a limited collection of ultra-luxury gated villas in Benahavís, Spain, developed by DarGlobal with design inspired by Automobili Lamborghini. Villas are staggered across the hillside at different levels in the Los Jaralillos district to ensure every home captures unobstructed panoramas of the Mediterranean Sea.

### What is Automobili Lamborghini's involvement in Tierra Viva?

Automobili Lamborghini provided the design inspiration for Tierra Viva, with the project integrating the brand's approach to cutting-edge design, technology, and artisanal craftsmanship into villa architecture and interiors. The collaboration between DarGlobal and Lamborghini positions Tierra Viva as a convergence of performance culture and ultra-luxury residential living.

### What villa sizes are available at Tierra Viva?

Tierra Viva offers a limited collection of villas ranging from 700 to 1,450 sqm. The collection is available in different villa configurations, including select units with an in-villa car lift. Contact DarGlobal for current unit availability and full specification details.

### When will Tierra Viva be completed?

Tierra Viva is under development with completion scheduled for June 2028. Construction is actively underway, with progress updates available on the DarGlobal website. Contact the sales team for current payment plan terms and unit availability.

### Where exactly is Tierra Viva located?

Tierra Viva is in the hills of Los Jaralillos, Benahavís, 15 minutes from Marbella and within easy reach of Puerto Banús and Sotogrande. The location gives direct access to 12 nearby golf clubs, Andalusian villages, and the shores of the Mediterranean, while remaining in one of the most prestigious residential areas on the Costa Del Sol.

### What amenities does Tierra Viva offer?

Tierra Viva is a gated community with 24/7 premium security, an exclusive residents' clubhouse, sauna, steam room, and private pool areas. Select Painite villas include an in-villa car lift. The community is designed around the concept of seclusion and belonging rather than shared hotel-style facilities.

### Can I obtain a Spain Golden Visa by purchasing at Tierra Viva?

Spain's Golden Visa programme is available to non-EU buyers making qualifying real estate investments. Given villa sizes and values at Tierra Viva, buyers should confirm current programme thresholds and eligibility with a qualified legal adviser, as Spain's Golden Visa rules have been subject to legislative review. DarGlobal can assist with introductions to legal professionals.

### Why invest in Costa Del Sol real estate?

Spain is consistently ranked as offering among the highest real estate ROI in Europe, with low Eurozone interest rates between 3 and 5%, open regulations for foreign investors, and a robust tourism sector that supports rental returns. Benahavís specifically is one of the wealthiest municipalities in Spain and benefits from year-round Mediterranean climate and high-speed train connections to the wider coast.

### What makes a Lamborghini-branded villa different from other luxury villas in Spain?

Branded residences at this tier consistently command significant price premiums over comparable unbranded stock. Tierra Viva combines the scarcity of a limited villa collection in Benahavís, one of Europe's most sought-after addresses, with a globally recognised automotive design brand. That pairing targets a very specific international buyer pool, which supports both value retention and resale appetite.

### How do I register interest or buy a villa at Tierra Viva?

Buyers can register interest, browse the collection, or download the project brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can provide current villa availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

content.description: The Painite Villas are the only villas in the South of Spain with the exclusive Sky Car Lift with technology by Automobili Lamborghini. Located in the hills of Benahavis, overlooking Marbella, the Painite Villas rise out from the hills, offering panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea and the Andalusian landscape. The villas fitted with Automobili Lamborghini interiors have their very own private car elevator. The Sky Car Lift has access to both levels of the villa, seamlessly integrating your supercar into your living space.

content.title: PRIVATE SKY CAR LIFT
content.description: The entrance to the Painite Villa is nothing short of breathtaking. As you drive into the villa via the Sky Car Lift, you're enveloped in a protective glass dome that offers a stunning 360-degree view of your supercar. Inside, you're greeted by spacious, light-filled interiors where floor-to-ceiling windows seamlessly blend the indoors with the outdoors. Here, your supercar is the centerpiece, showcased like a piece of art against the magnificent backdrop of the Mediterranean Sea.

content.title: THE VILLA
content.description: The villa boasts six luxurious bedrooms, expansive roof terraces, and panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from every angle. Complementing this are the extensive swimming pool and lush, meticulously designed gardens, making the villa a gateway to unparalleled luxury.

content.title: THE VIEWS
content.description: The Painite Villas are masterfully positioned on the hilltops, where careful leveling ensures that each villa enjoys unobstructed, panoramic views. From this elevated vantage point, the villas offer breathtaking vistas that stretch across the horizon, providing an uninterrupted connection to the surrounding landscape. The strategic placement of these villas maximizes the stunning scenery and creates a sense of serenity and exclusivity.

content.title: THE AMENITIES
content.description: Each villa features expansive roof terraces that provide an ideal setting for relaxation or entertaining, all while enjoying panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from every angle. The outdoor space is thoughtfully designed, offering a perfect spot for a pool if desired, and is surrounded by meticulously landscaped luxury gardens that offer a serene escape. Every aspect of these villas is crafted to create a harmonious blend of luxury, comfort, and natural beauty.

content.title: LOCATION
content.description: The Painite Villas are located in Tierra Viva in Marbella, one of the most affluent locations around the world. Home to the most stylish clubs, restaurants and hotels, as well as, shopping areas, exclusive marinas and breathtaking beaches. The villas are precisely nestled in the hills, only minutes away from the shores and in close proximity to 9 golf clubs, numerous Andalusian villages and Puerto Banus.

content.title: Albert Hall Mansions History
content.description: Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.

content.title: A prestigious Address
content.description: The Albert Hall Mansion is situated in one of London’s most prestigious neighborhoods, directly overlooking the iconic Royal Albert Hall. The location provides the perfect balance between the vibrant energy of city life and the tranquility of a refined residential area.

content.title: Albert Hall Mansions History
content.description: Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.

### What is Marea, Interiors by Missoni?

Marea, Interiors by Missoni is an exclusive branded residential community within the Finca Cortesin gated estate on Costa Del Sol, Spain, developed by DarGlobal. Missoni provided the interior design across the collection of two-, three-, and four-bedroom residences, which overlook the Mediterranean Sea and an elite golf course set against a 270-degree panorama.

### What did Missoni design at Marea?

Missoni's design team was responsible for the interiors throughout the residences, bringing the Italian fashion house's signature approach to colour, pattern, and material quality into kitchens, bathrooms, and living spaces. The brand-led interiors give each residence a distinctive identity beyond standard luxury specification.

### What unit types and sizes are available at Marea?

Marea offers two-, three-, and four-bedroom residences ranging from 223 to 553 sqm. The community is a gated complex within the Finca Cortesin estate, with each unit designed for the panoramic sea and mountain views the site commands.

### When will Marea, Interiors by Missoni be completed?

Phase 1 of Marea completed in 2024. The full development is scheduled for completion in December 2027. The project is under development by DarGlobal. Contact the sales team for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan terms.

### Where is Marea, Interiors by Missoni located?

Marea sits within the Finca Cortesin gated estate in Cortesin, Costa Del Sol. The beach is 5 minutes away, Marbella is 20 minutes, Puerto Banús and Sotogrande are a 20-minute drive, Santa Maria Polo Club is 15 minutes, Gibraltar Airport is 45 minutes, and Malaga Airport is 50 minutes.

### What is the 270-degree view at Marea?

The site's elevation and orientation give residences an unobstructed 270-degree panorama that stretches from Marbella along the Costa Del Sol coastline, across to Gibraltar, and continues to the mountains of Morocco on the African continent, with the Mediterranean Sea and Finca Cortesin golf course directly below.

### What amenities does Marea, Interiors by Missoni offer?

### What is the Finca Cortesin estate?

Costa Del Sol combines Spain's highest real estate ROI in Europe with Eurozone interest rates between 3 and 5%, a Mediterranean climate year-round, and strong tourism that supports rental demand. Cortesin's proximity to Marbella, Sotogrande, and Gibraltar positions it within a corridor that draws international buyers and second-home investors consistently.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Les Vagues by Elie Saab?

Les Vagues by Elie Saab is a branded seafront residential complex on Qetaifan Island North, Doha, developed by DarGlobal. Elie Saab provided the interior design for each residence and the building's common areas, bringing the Lebanese fashion house's signature aesthetic of cream, marble, bronze, and premium stone to one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments.

### What did Elie Saab design at Les Vagues?

Elie Saab was responsible for the full interior design of each residence, as well as the building's lounges and lobby areas, personally selecting all furniture for the common spaces. The design palette centres on cream and grey tones, shiny metal finishes, bronze, marble, and premium stone, reflecting the couture-level craftsmanship the house is known for.

### What unit types and sizes are available at Les Vagues?

Les Vagues offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences ranging from 86 to 389 sqm on Qetaifan Island North. Units are served by four personal elevators per building including a service elevator, and sit within a gated seafront complex with an infinity pool and landscaped sea-view courtyard.

### When will Les Vagues by Elie Saab be completed?

Les Vagues is under development with completion scheduled for December 2027. Construction is actively underway on Qetaifan Island North. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan terms.

### Where is Les Vagues located?

Les Vagues is on Qetaifan Island North, a 1.3 million sqm man-made island off the coast of Doha, Qatar. The development is 30 minutes from Hamad International Airport, within minutes of Qatar's largest theme park, and sits alongside 7 km of beach shoreline, a vibrant marina, and a signature 18-hole golf course and clubhouse.

### What amenities does Les Vagues offer within the building?

Building amenities include an infinity swimming pool, state-of-the-art fitness centre, four personal elevators per unit including a service elevator, 24-hour reception, luxury retail, covered parking for all units, and a landscaped community courtyard with sea views. Lobby and lounge furniture was designed and personally selected by Elie Saab.

### What lifestyle facilities does Qetaifan Island North offer?

Qetaifan Island North delivers 7 km of beach shoreline, private beaches, a marina, world-class boating facilities, boutique shopping, a water park, a winter garden, a signature 18-hole golf course and clubhouse, and 5-star hotels and amenities, functioning as a fully self-contained luxury destination in Doha.

### Why invest in Qatar real estate?

Qatar offers a Golden Visa with an investment of $200,000, 0% property tax, 100% foreign business ownership, and one of the world's highest GDP per capita figures. Qatar hosted the FIFA World Cup 2022 and processes approximately 40 million tourists annually through Hamad International Airport, consistently rated the world's best.

### Is Les Vagues by Elie Saab a good investment?

Les Vagues sits on a purpose-built island destination with a diversified lifestyle offering, in one of the Gulf's most politically stable and tax-efficient markets. Elie Saab-branded residences occupy a distinct position in Doha's luxury market, and branded product consistently commands a premium over comparable unbranded stock. Buyers should seek independent investment advice on suitability.

### How do I register interest or buy at Les Vagues by Elie Saab?

Buyers can register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can provide current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Trump International Hotel Oman?

Trump International Hotel Oman is a luxury hotel at AIDA, Muscat, where investors purchase freehold ownership of individual rooms or suites. The hotel is managed by Trump Hotels, and owners earn a share of revenue from guest bookings while receiving two weeks of complimentary personal use each year.

### What does owning a hotel room at Trump International Hotel Oman mean?

Owners hold freehold title to a specific room or suite within the hotel. Trump Hotels manages the property professionally, generating rental income from guest bookings. Owners receive a share of that revenue and retain two weeks annually for personal use, giving a tangible asset with managed returns.

### What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel Oman?

The hotel offers rooms, junior suites, and suites ranging from 43 to 138 sqm. All units are managed by Trump Hotels as part of the hotel's operational inventory, ensuring professional management and a consistent stream of bookings.

### When will Trump International Hotel Oman be completed?

Completion is scheduled for December 2028. The hotel is under development within the AIDA master community in Muscat. Contact DarGlobal for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details.

### Where is Trump International Hotel Oman located?

The hotel is within AIDA, a master-planned destination in Muscat, rising 130 metres above sea level and 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport. AIDA includes a championship golf course, beach, night club, wellness centres, hiking and mountain bike trails, retail, and dining venues.

### What are the benefits of hotel room ownership versus residential investment?

Hotel room ownership generates passive income from guest bookings, comes with full Trump Hotels professional management, and includes two weeks of complimentary personal use per year. Owners hold freehold title to a tangible hospitality asset without the management burden of private rental.

### Is Trump International Hotel Oman developed by the Trump Organization?

No. The sub-developer is Dar al Arkan Property Development SPC, which uses the Trump name and mark under sublicense from DT Marks Oman LLC. The Trump Organization and its affiliates are not the owners, developers, or sellers of the property.

### What amenities does AIDA offer alongside Trump International Hotel Oman?

AIDA features the Trump International Golf Club, Trump Member Club, Cliff Night Club, AIDA Beach, hanging suites, sky bar, all-day dining, swimming pools, wellness and fitness centres, hiking and mountain bike trails, a viewing deck, children's splash areas, parks, and promenades.

### Why invest in Oman real estate?

Oman offers 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, 0% inheritance tax, 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities within Integrated Tourism Complexes, and lifetime residency visas for qualifying investors. Oman ranked 7th globally in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index 2023, with tourism projected to generate $22.5 billion by 2040.

### How do I register interest or buy a hotel room at Trump International Hotel Oman?

Prospective buyers can register interest, explore available units, or download the brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current pricing, unit availability, and payment plan terms on request.

### What are Trump Cliff Villas at AIDA?

Trump Cliff Villas are a collection of fully furnished three-bedroom sea-view villas at AIDA, Muscat, developed by DarGlobal. Each villa is positioned directly beside the Trump International Hotel at 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera, with a private pool overlooking the sea. Villas are designed and furnished to the highest standard, with every detail specified down to specification.

### What are the villa sizes and unit types available?

Trump Cliff Villas offer three-bedroom furnished residences from 128 to 166 sqm. Each villa includes a private pool with sea views. Owners receive a Trump International Golf Club Social Membership as part of the purchase and have the option to reside in or lease the villa.

### What does the Trump Cliff Villas offer that other AIDA products do not?

Trump Cliff Villas offer full villa ownership with a private pool, the closest positioning to the Trump International Hotel, and the most elevated sea views on the AIDA estate. Unlike Trump Golf Villas, which face the golf course, These villas are positioned on the cliff edge with direct sea orientation. Both villa products sit within the same AIDA estate and share access to the same championship golf course and community facilities.

### What amenities are available to Trump Cliff Villa owners?

Within the AIDA estate, villa owners have access to the Trump International Golf Club Oman (18-hole championship course), Trump Members Only Club, The SHFT Night Club, 5-star dining and culinary facilities, AIDA Beach, Trump Hotels Hanging Suites, a Trump International Hotel lobby, community and retail centres, plazas, cafes and restaurants, wellness centres, fitness centre, promenades, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, viewing decks, and outdoor landscapes across the cliffside estate.

### When will Trump Cliff Villas be completed?

Completion is scheduled for December 2028. Construction is underway and live progress feeds are available on the DarGlobal project page. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk to book a unit, choose your residence via the online navigator, or download the project brochure.

### Can I lease my Trump Cliff Villa when I am not using it?

Yes. The entry data states that owners have the choice to reside in or lease their villa. The Trump management association with the property supports the leasing proposition. Contact DarGlobal for further details on the leasing model and revenue arrangements.

### Can foreign nationals buy Trump Cliff Villas in Oman?

Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. ITC project buyers are eligible for a lifetime residency visa in Oman. An exclusive mortgage program is available in Oman for both resident and non-resident buyers. Buyers should confirm specific eligibility conditions with DarGlobal or their legal advisor.

### What are the tax advantages of investing in Oman real estate?

Oman applies 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws. Businesses in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes.

### Why invest in Muscat property now?

Oman ranked 7th globally and 1st in both Asia and the Arab world in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index in 2023, and is one of the safest countries in the world. Tourism earnings are projected to exceed $22.5 billion per year by 2040. The Saudi-Oman Highway cuts travel time between the two countries by 16 hours, and an upcoming UAE-Muscat railway project will further strengthen connectivity and investment activity.

### How do Trump Cliff Villas relate to the wider AIDA development?

Trump Cliff Villas are one of several residential products within the AIDA estate in Muscat. Other DarGlobal products at AIDA include Trump International Hotel Oman (hotel room ownership), Trump Golf Villas (five-bedroom fairway villas), Marriott Residences Aida, The Great Escape 2, and Sunrise Haven. ## Frequently Asked Questions

### What are Trump Golf Villas at AIDA?

Trump Golf Villas are a collection of five-bedroom luxury villas at AIDA, Muscat, developed by DarGlobal. Each villa is positioned directly along the Trump International Championship Golf Course, 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera, with open views across the fairways and the sea. Every residence includes a branded golf cart for private use across the estate.

### Where are Trump Golf Villas located?

The villas are within the AIDA estate in Muscat, Oman, 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport. The estate sits in close proximity to a cluster of 5-star hospitality landmarks including the Ritz Carlton, Shangri-La Resort, Nikki Beach, and Jumeirah Muscat Bay Hotel.

### What are the villa sizes and unit types available?

Trump Golf Villas offer five-bedroom residences from 4,367 sqft. Villas include open terraces and balconies with dual golf and sea views, and each unit comes with a complimentary branded golf cart for use across the AIDA estate. Contact DarGlobal for current unit availability and pricing.

### What amenities does the AIDA estate offer?

AIDA provides access to the Trump International Golf Club Oman, gated community security, wellness centres, a fitness centre, plazas, cafes and restaurants, hiking trails, mountain biking routes, running trails, a viewing deck, parks and recreational spaces, luxury hotel neighbours, and extensive outdoor landscaping across the cliffside estate.

### When will Trump Golf Villas be completed?

Completion is scheduled for December 2028. Construction is actively underway. Live progress feeds are available on the DarGlobal project page. Contact the sales team at darglobal.co.uk for current availability and payment plan details.

### Can foreign nationals buy Trump Golf Villas in Oman?

Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. Buyers in ITC-registered projects are also eligible for a lifetime residency visa. Buyers should confirm specific eligibility conditions with the DarGlobal sales team or their legal advisor.

### What are the tax advantages of buying property in Oman?

Oman applies 0% personal income tax and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws rather than local law. Businesses operating in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes. The Omani Rial is pegged to the US Dollar, providing currency stability for international investors.

### Why invest in Muscat real estate now?

Oman is one of the safest countries in the world and ranked 7th globally and 1st in both Asia and the Arab world in the Quality of Life Index by Numbeo in 2023. Oman aims to earn over $22.5 billion a year from tourism by 2040, and an upcoming railway project connecting the UAE to Muscat, alongside the Saudi-Oman Highway, is significantly improving regional connectivity and driving investment.

### How does the Trump Golf Villas product relate to the wider AIDA development?

AIDA is DarGlobal's flagship cliffside resort development in Muscat, which includes the Trump International Hotel Oman (a hotel room ownership product) as well as the Trump Golf Villas (a standalone residential villa product). The golf villas offer freehold residential ownership of a full five-bedroom villa, with the Trump International Championship Golf Course as an on-doorstep amenity.

### How do I register interest or buy a Trump Golf Villa?

Buyers can register interest, book a unit, choose their residence via the online navigator, or download the brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk/aida-trump-villas. The sales team can provide current pricing, availability, and payment plan terms on request.

## Frequently Asked Questions - AIDA

Find answers about AIDA by DarGlobal in Muscat, Oman, including property ownership, branded residences, lifestyle amenities, and investment potential.

### What is AIDA by DarGlobal and what makes this development unique?

AIDA is a fully master-planned destination in Muscat, Oman, designed as a city within a city. Developed by DarGlobal, it combines luxury residences, branded hotels, golf courses, nature, and lifestyle amenities in one integrated community.

### Where is AIDA located in Oman?

AIDA is in Muscat, Oman, about 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport, elevated 130 meters above sea level along the coastline, offering scenic views.

### Can international buyers own property at AIDA?

Yes. AIDA offers 100% foreign ownership within designated investment zones, ideal for investors and second-home buyers.

### How can I register my interest or book a viewing at AIDA?

You can register your interest through [our website](https://darglobal.co.uk/) or by visiting one of [our offices](https://darglobal.co.uk/get-in-touch).

If you are outside Oman, the sales team will contact you and arrange the most suitable way to connect.

If you are in Oman or planning a visit, you can visit the office and enjoy a private, one on one site tour, including a visit to the development, the views, and the latest construction updates.

### What types of properties are available at AIDA?

AIDA offers apartments, luxury villas, hotel residences, and branded or non-branded residences. Explore your options for investment or lifestyle living.

### Are there branded residences at AIDA?

Yes. AIDA features branded residences in collaboration with internationally recognized brands, including Trump and Marriott.

### Does property ownership include golf access?

Golf access is available through membership at Trump International Golf Club Oman, subject to application and approval.

### Who is developing AIDA in Oman?

AIDA is a master plan developed by DarGlobal in partnership with OMRAN, collaborating with global brands such as the [Trump Organization](https://darglobal.co.uk/partners/the-trump-organization) and [Marriott](https://darglobal.co.uk/partners/marriott-residences-aida-oman).

### What makes AIDA a city within a city?

AIDA offers residential living, hospitality, leisure, wellness, retail, and outdoor experiences all in one destination, allowing residents to live, relax, and socialize without leaving the community.

### Is AIDA a gated community in Muscat, Oman?

Yes. AIDA is a private, gated community in Muscat offering controlled access, security, and a secure residential environment designed for privacy and peace of mind.

### Who is AIDA designed for?

AIDA is designed for end users, second-home owners, and international investors seeking a luxury resort lifestyle, long-term value, and globally benchmarked living standards in Oman.

### How accessible is AIDA from the region?

AIDA is accessible with a 60-minute flight from Dubai and has strong connections to regional and international destinations.

### What views are available from properties at AIDA?

Homes at AIDA offer sea views, golf course views, or valley/wadi views. The master plan integrates natural landscapes with parks and elevated viewpoints.

### How is nature integrated into the master plan?

AIDA features landscaped parks, hiking and cycling trails, and outdoor adventure zones, blending luxury living with Oman’s natural environment.

### Is there a golf course at AIDA?

Yes, there is an 18-hole trump championship golf course.

### What is the AIDA Residence Club?

The AIDA Residence Club offers wellness, leisure, dining, and community facilities exclusively for residents.

### Is AIDA suitable for families?

Yes. AIDA is designed for families, with amenities and spaces suited for all age groups.

### Does owning property at AIDA provide residency benefits?

Eligible property ownership gives access to lifetime residency in Oman, subject to regulations.

### Are financing and payment plans available at AIDA?

Buyers can access mortgage solutions and structured payment plans, typically linked to construction milestones.

### Can I rent out my property at AIDA?

Yes. Approved properties can be rented on a short-term basis, with professional management services available.

### What amenities are available at AIDA?

Amenities include swimming pools, parks, wellness and fitness centers, restaurants, kids’ play areas, outdoor cinemas, and adventure zones.

### Are properties at AIDA managed?

Yes. Selected residences and hotel units are fully managed, including Trump International Hotel and Trump Cliff Villas, for hassle-free ownership.

### Is rental management available at AIDA?

Yes. Owners can opt for rental management services to generate income from eligible units.

### What are the key residences at AIDA?

AIDA includes [Trump Golf Villas](https://darglobal.co.uk/aida-trump-villas), [Trump Cliff Villas](https://darglobal.co.uk/aida-trump-international-cliff-villas), [Fairway Villas](https://darglobal.co.uk/fairway-villas-aida-oman), [The Great Escape](https://darglobal.co.uk/the-great-escape-1-aida-oman), [Marriott Residences](https://darglobal.co.uk/marriott-residences-aida-oman) and [more](https://darglobal.co.uk/projects/properties-in-oman), each offering unique designs, views, and lifestyle benefits.

content.title: SIDE BY SIDE
content.description: The Painite Villas are the only villas in the South of Spain with the exclusive Sky Car Lift with technology by Automobili Lamborghini. Located in the hills of Benahavis, overlooking Marbella, the Painite Villas rise out from the hills, offering panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea and the Andalusian landscape. The villas fitted with Automobili Lamborghini interiors have their very own private car elevator. The Sky Car Lift has access to both levels of the villa, seamlessly integrating your supercar into your living space.

content.title: PRIVATE SKY CAR LIFT
content.description: The entrance to the Painite Villa is nothing short of breathtaking. As you drive into the villa via the Sky Car Lift, you're enveloped in a protective glass dome that offers a stunning 360-degree view of your supercar. Inside, you're greeted by spacious, light-filled interiors where floor-to-ceiling windows seamlessly blend the indoors with the outdoors. Here, your supercar is the centerpiece, showcased like a piece of art against the magnificent backdrop of the Mediterranean Sea.

content.title: THE VILLA
content.description: The villa boasts six luxurious bedrooms, expansive roof terraces, and panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from every angle. Complementing this are the extensive swimming pool and lush, meticulously designed gardens, making the villa a gateway to unparalleled luxury.

content.title: THE VIEWS
content.description: The Painite Villas are masterfully positioned on the hilltops, where careful leveling ensures that each villa enjoys unobstructed, panoramic views. From this elevated vantage point, the villas offer breathtaking vistas that stretch across the horizon, providing an uninterrupted connection to the surrounding landscape. The strategic placement of these villas maximizes the stunning scenery and creates a sense of serenity and exclusivity.

content.title: THE AMENITIES
content.description: Each villa features expansive roof terraces that provide an ideal setting for relaxation or entertaining, all while enjoying panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from every angle. The outdoor space is thoughtfully designed, offering a perfect spot for a pool if desired, and is surrounded by meticulously landscaped luxury gardens that offer a serene escape. Every aspect of these villas is crafted to create a harmonious blend of luxury, comfort, and natural beauty.

content.title: LOCATION
content.description: The Painite Villas are located in Tierra Viva in Marbella, one of the most affluent locations around the world. Home to the most stylish clubs, restaurants and hotels, as well as, shopping areas, exclusive marinas and breathtaking beaches. The villas are precisely nestled in the hills, only minutes away from the shores and in close proximity to 9 golf clubs, numerous Andalusian villages and Puerto Banus.

content.title: Albert Hall Mansions History
content.description: Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.

content.title: A prestigious Address
content.description: The Albert Hall Mansion is situated in one of London’s most prestigious neighborhoods, directly overlooking the iconic Royal Albert Hall. This historic and architecturally significant building offers residents breathtaking views as well as an exclusive address. The location provides the perfect balance between the vibrant energy of city life and the tranquility of a refined residential area.

Interiors reflect the brand’s signature approach to craftsmanship and detail, combining refined materials with a contemporary design language.
Custom furnishings, sculptural elements, and curated finishes create spaces that are both functional and expressive.

![25204-SE-DG-ZZ-CGI-ID-000008 1.png](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/25204_SE_DG_ZZ_CGI_ID_000008_1_028f57dc94.png)

## THE VILLAS SPECS

Five-bedroom villas designed with a focus on proportion, functionality, and material quality.

Key features include:

• Branded interiors by FENDI Casa

• Open-plan living and dining areas

• Bespoke finishes and materials

• Expansive glazing to maximise natural light

• Carefully planned layouts for privacy and flow

Each villa is composed to balance design clarity with everyday usability.

![25204-SE-DG-ZZ-CGI-ID-0000010 1.png](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/25204_SE_DG_ZZ_CGI_ID_0000010_1_d16f05720f.png)

Each residence includes private outdoor spaces designed as extensions of the interior.

• Expansive terraces

• Landscaped gardens

• Infinity-edge swimming pools

These elements are positioned to create continuity between indoor and outdoor living.

![c01_1 1.png](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/c01_1_1_208711eebb.png)

## THE VIEWS

All villas are oriented toward the sea, ensuring uninterrupted views of the horizon.
There are no structures above or in front, allowing full visual openness and a direct connection to the surrounding landscape.

![25204-SE-DG-ZZ-CGI-ID-0000011 1.png](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/25204_SE_DG_ZZ_CGI_ID_0000011_1_25ce108f14.png)

AIDA is a gated clifftop community overlooking the Gulf of Oman, spanning over 4.3 million sqm.

The city integrates residential, golfing, and hospitality components, including:

• Trump International Golf Club

• Luxury hotels and resorts

• Beaches and coastal access

• Wellness and outdoor facilities

Located approximately 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport, AIDA offers both accessibility and seclusion.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?

Marriott Residences Aida, Oman is a fully furnished branded apartment complex at AIDA, Muscat. The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which uses the Marriott name under license from Marriott International. Residences come with à la carte hotel-style services and are designed to deliver the comfort and standard associated with the Marriott brand.

### Who developed Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?

The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which operates the Marriott brand name under a licensing agreement with Marriott International, Inc. Marriott Residences Aida, Oman are not owned, developed, or sold by Marriott International or its affiliates.

### What unit types and sizes are available?

The development offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom fully furnished apartments ranging from 60 to 194 sqm. Each residence is designed with contemporary decor and thoughtfully furnished to offer stylish, comfortable living with seamless integration across all spaces.

### What services do residents receive at Marriott Residences?

Residents benefit from à la carte services styled around the Marriott standard, including a dedicated concierge, 24-hour reception desk, doorman, lobby, and valet. The service model is designed to bring hotel-quality living to private residential ownership at the AIDA estate.

### What amenities does AIDA offer for Marriott Residences owners?

The AIDA estate provides a championship golf course, swimming pools, a private beach enclave, children's splash areas, wellness centres, fitness centre, plazas, cafes and restaurants, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, promenades, viewing decks, parks, a clubhouse, outdoor landscapes, and access to nearby 5-star hotels including Nikki Beach, Al Bustan Palace Ritz-Carlton, Shangri-La, and Jumeirah Muscat Bay.

### When will Marriott Residences Aida, Oman be completed?

Completion is expected in September 2029. The development is currently under construction. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk to register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure.

### Can foreign nationals buy property at Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?

Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. Buyers on ITC-registered projects are eligible for a lifetime residency visa. An exclusive mortgage program is also available in Oman for both resident and non-resident buyers.

### What are the tax advantages of investing in Oman?

Oman applies 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws rather than local law. Businesses in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes.

### Why invest in Muscat real estate now?

Oman ranked 7th globally and 1st in Asia and the Arab world in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index in 2023, and is one of the safest countries worldwide. The country targets over $22.5 billion per year from tourism by 2040. The Saudi-Oman Highway cuts travel time by 16 hours between the two countries, and an upcoming railway project connecting the UAE to Muscat will further strengthen regional connectivity and investment appeal.

### How does Marriott Residences relate to the wider AIDA development?

Marriott Residences is one of several residential products within the AIDA estate in Muscat. Other DarGlobal projects at AIDA include Trump International Hotel Oman, Trump Golf Villas, The Great Escape 2, and Sunrise Haven. Together they form a multi-branded, fully integrated resort community 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera.

content.title: SIDE BY SIDE
content.description: The Painite Villas are the only villas in the South of Spain with the exclusive Sky Car Lift with technology by Automobili Lamborghini. Located in the hills of Benahavis, overlooking Marbella, the Painite Villas rise out from the hills, offering panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea and the Andalusian landscape. The villas fitted with Automobili Lamborghini interiors have their very own private car elevator. The Sky Car Lift has access to both levels of the villa, seamlessly integrating your supercar into your living space.

content.title: PRIVATE SKY CAR LIFT
content.description: The entrance to the Painite Villa is nothing short of breathtaking. As you drive into the villa via the Sky Car Lift, you're enveloped in a protective glass dome that offers a stunning 360-degree view of your supercar. Inside, you're greeted by spacious, light-filled interiors where floor-to-ceiling windows seamlessly blend the indoors with the outdoors. Here, your supercar is the centerpiece, showcased like a piece of art against the magnificent backdrop of the Mediterranean Sea.

content.title: THE VILLA
content.description: The villa boasts six luxurious bedrooms, expansive roof terraces, and panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from every angle. Complementing this are the extensive swimming pool and lush, meticulously designed gardens, making the villa a gateway to unparalleled luxury.

content.title: THE VIEWS
content.description: The Painite Villas are masterfully positioned on the hilltops, where careful leveling ensures that each villa enjoys unobstructed, panoramic views. From this elevated vantage point, the villas offer breathtaking vistas that stretch across the horizon, providing an uninterrupted connection to the surrounding landscape. The strategic placement of these villas maximizes the stunning scenery and creates a sense of serenity and exclusivity.

content.title: THE AMENITIES
content.description: Each villa features expansive roof terraces that provide an ideal setting for relaxation or entertaining, all while enjoying panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from every angle. The outdoor space is thoughtfully designed, offering a perfect spot for a pool if desired, and is surrounded by meticulously landscaped luxury gardens that offer a serene escape. Every aspect of these villas is crafted to create a harmonious blend of luxury, comfort, and natural beauty.

content.title: LOCATION
content.description: The Painite Villas are located in Tierra Viva in Marbella, one of the most affluent locations around the world. Home to the most stylish clubs, restaurants and hotels, as well as, shopping areas, exclusive marinas and breathtaking beaches. The villas are precisely nestled in the hills, only minutes away from the shores and in close proximity to 9 golf clubs, numerous Andalusian villages and Puerto Banus.

content.title: Albert Hall Mansions History
content.description: Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.

content.title: A prestigious Address
content.description: The Albert Hall Mansion is situated in one of London’s most prestigious neighborhoods, directly overlooking the iconic Royal Albert Hall. This historic and architecturally significant building offers residents breathtaking views as well as an exclusive address. The location provides the perfect balance between the vibrant energy of city life and the tranquility of a refined residential area.

content.title: Location
content.description: Albert Hall Mansions is ideally located in one of London's most prestigious neighborhoods, directly overlooking the iconic Royal Albert Hall. This historic building offers breathtaking views and an exclusive address, balancing the vibrant energy of city life with the tranquility of a refined residential area. Situated in South Kensington, residents have access to Hyde Park, the Victoria and Albert Museum, and the luxury shopping of Knightsbridge, along with an array of fine dining, shopping, and cultural attractions. This location is perfect for those seeking a sophisticated and dynamic lifestyle.

faqs.question: What types of properties are available at Amaya?

children.text: Amaya is a 1-million-square-meter master-planned community by Dar Global in central Jeddah. In addition to completed villas and custom land plots, Amaya offers townhouses, mid-to-high-rise residential and commercial plots, and branded or serviced residences, including Trump Plaza.

faqs.question: Is Jeddah good for property investment?

children.text: Jeddah is one of Saudi Arabia's largest and most active real estate markets, driven by its status as a commercial hub and gateway city on the Red Sea coast. Demand for residential property in Jeddah is supported by a growing population, ongoing infrastructure investment, and ambitious national development plans under Saudi Vision 2030. Villas and land plots, like those offered at
Amaya

, tend to appeal to buyers seeking long-term ownership and the option to customize their homes. For buyers considering the Gulf Cooperation Council region, Jeddah offers a relatively stable entry point into a maturing property market with room for continued growth.

faqs.question: How much does a villa or plot in Jeddah cost?

children.text: Pricing for villas and land plots at
Amaya
in Jeddah depends on unit size, plot dimensions, and current inventory availability.
DarGlobal
has not published a fixed price list for the community, as costs vary based on the specific villa type or plot chosen. Buyers interested in
Amaya

should reach out directly to DarGlobal or an authorized sales representative to get up-to-date pricing for available units. This approach ensures buyers receive accurate figures reflecting the latest release phase and any applicable offers.

faqs.question: Jeddah vs Riyadh — which is better to buy property?

children.text: Amaya sits in a prime central location along King Abdulaziz Road, directly opposite the Red Sea Mall and minutes from the Jeddah Corniche. This gives buyers a coastal lifestyle address with direct connectivity to key urban and historic hubs.

faqs.question: What is the process for buying property in Jeddah?

children.text: Amaya offers full freehold ownership options for foreign buyers. Additionally, qualifying real estate investments at Amaya may enable eligible international buyers to apply for the Saudi Premium Residency.

faqs.question: What amenities are near Amaya?

children.text: In addition to nearby schools, medical clinics, and mosques, Amaya features signature community amenities. These include a 700-meter central parkland, shaded green walking trails, integrated retail courtyards, and the 4,000-square-meter members-only Vitality Club.

faqs.question: Can I buy a plot at Amaya and build my own villa?

children.text: Yes,

faqs.question: What did Mouawad design at Neptune?

faqs.question: What villa sizes are available at Neptune?

children.text: Neptune offers five-bedroom villas with built-up areas ranging from 300 to 420 sqm. Each villa includes a master bedroom with walk-in closet and en-suite, secondary bedrooms, a family kitchen, guest living area, and terrace with views of the surrounding landscape.

faqs.question: When will Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad be completed?

children.text: The project is under development with completion scheduled for December 2027. DarGlobal is the master developer. Contact the sales team for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan terms, or explore available villas via the online residence navigator.

faqs.question: Where is Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad located?

children.text: Neptune is in the northern district of Riyadh, positioned in close proximity to the Expo 2030 Riyadh site, placing residents at the centre of one of Saudi Arabia's most significant urban development corridors under Vision 2030.

faqs.question: What community amenities surround Neptune?

children.text: The Neptune community is supported by schools, a community centre, sports hub, restaurants and cafes, public parks, entertainment centres, early childhood centres, retail and grocery, playgrounds, mosques, and healthcare clinics within the wider neighbourhood.

faqs.question: Is Riyadh real estate open to foreign investors?

children.text: Yes. Full freehold ownership is now available to foreign investors in Saudi Arabia. Property investment of 4 million SAR or more qualifies buyers for residency eligibility. The Saudi Riyal is pegged to the US Dollar, providing currency stability, and Saudi Arabia applies 0% capital gains tax, 0% wealth tax, and 0% inheritance tax.

faqs.question: Why invest in Riyadh property under Saudi Vision 2030?

Saudi Arabia is considered one of the safest countries globally and the safest in the G20.

faqs.question: What makes Neptune a limited-edition collection?

The scarcity of a Mouawad-branded residential product in Riyadh places it in a distinct tier above standard luxury villa developments in the city.

Neptune offers five-bedroom villas with built-up areas ranging from 300 to 420 sqm. Each villa includes a master bedroom with walk-in closet and en-suite, secondary bedrooms, a family kitchen, guest living area, and terrace with views of the surrounding landscape.

### When will Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad be completed?

The project is under development with completion scheduled for December 2027. DarGlobal is the master developer. Contact the sales team for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan terms, or explore available villas via the online residence navigator.

### Where is Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad located?

Neptune is in the northern district of Riyadh, positioned in close proximity to the Expo 2030 Riyadh site, placing residents at the centre of one of Saudi Arabia's most significant urban development corridors under Vision 2030.

### What community amenities surround Neptune?

The Neptune community is supported by schools, a community centre, sports hub, restaurants and cafes, public parks, entertainment centres, early childhood centres, retail and grocery, playgrounds, mosques, and healthcare clinics within the wider neighbourhood.

### Is Riyadh real estate open to foreign investors?

Yes. Full freehold ownership is now available to foreign investors in Saudi Arabia. Property investment of 4 million SAR or more qualifies buyers for residency eligibility. The Saudi Riyal is pegged to the US Dollar, providing currency stability, and Saudi Arabia applies 0% capital gains tax, 0% wealth tax, and 0% inheritance tax.

### Why invest in Riyadh property under Saudi Vision 2030?

Riyadh is set to host the FIFA World Cup 2034, Expo 2030, Formula 1, and the Asian Games, driving unprecedented infrastructure investment. King Salman International Airport is scaling to 185 million passengers, and Riyadh Air is expanding global connectivity. Saudi Arabia is considered one of the safest countries globally and the safest in the G20.

### What makes Neptune a limited-edition collection?

Neptune is positioned as a limited edition collection, meaning a restricted number of villas are available, each featuring bespoke Mouawad interiors and individual design attention that cannot be replicated at scale. The scarcity of a Mouawad-branded residential product in Riyadh places it in a distinct tier above standard luxury villa developments in the city.

### How do I register interest or buy a villa at Neptune?

Buyers can register interest, explore available villas via the online residence navigator, or download the project brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

Trump Tower Jeddah is a 47-floor Trump-branded seafront residential tower on the Jeddah Corniche, developed by DarGlobal. It offers one- to four-bedroom apartments and three- and four-bedroom penthouses with direct Red Sea views, alongside the Trump Private Club for residents and members.

The tower offers one-, two-, three-, and four-bedroom apartments as well as three- and four-bedroom penthouses, ranging from 70 to 365 sqm. All units are positioned on the Jeddah Corniche and face the Red Sea.

### When will Trump Tower Jeddah be completed?

Completion is scheduled for December 2029. The project is under development by DarGlobal. Buyers can contact the sales team directly for current availability, payment plan structure, and brochure download.

### Where exactly is Trump Tower Jeddah located?

The tower sits on the Jeddah Corniche along Saudi Arabia's Red Sea coastline. It offers easy access to the marina, the Formula 1 street circuit, and the King Fahd Fountain, placing residents at the intersection of coastal living and the city's key landmarks.

### Is Trump Tower Jeddah developed by the Trump Organization?

No. Trump Tower Jeddah is owned and developed by DarGlobal Holdings Real Estate, which uses the Trump name and mark under a licensing agreement. The Trump Organization is not the owner, developer, or seller of the property.

### Why invest in Jeddah real estate under Saudi Vision 2030?

Saudi Arabia offers 0% income tax and capital gains tax, a 30-year corporate tax exemption, and premium Saudi residency eligibility for investments of 4 million SAR or more. The SAR is pegged to the US dollar, and Saudi Arabia hosts Expo 2030 and the 2034 FIFA World Cup.

### What makes Trump Tower Jeddah's location on the Corniche valuable?

The Jeddah Corniche is the city's most sought-after coastal address. The tower's seafront position, proximity to the marina and F1 circuit, and its Standing as one of the tallest buildings on the strip place it at the centre of Jeddah's long-term urban and tourism growth corridor.
